item.title: Hack Smarter SQL Fundamentals Lab Walkthrough
item.description:
Hack Smarter - SQL Fundamentals Lab Walkthrough

In this lab, the goal was to complete four SQL challenges by interacting directly with a live SQLite database using raw SQL queries. Before solving the missions, it’s important to understand the database structure.

Step 1 - Identify the Database Type

The first thing I checked was which database management system was being used.

SELECT sqlite_version();

Explanation

The sqlite_version() function returns the version of SQLite currently running.
